provenance: Original selected vocabulary and literal templates; deterministic source-derived answers with no imported model weights or teacher distributions.
split_policy: Hold out unordered object pairs, including both sentence orders, both query targets, both fact forms, both query forms, and every location assignment. Remaining nine object pairs are training. Single-object prerequisites are training only.
assessment: A group has two swapped fact contexts times two queried objects. All four answers must be correct. Always copying the first/last location or ignoring the query cannot pass a group.
limits: Small controlled entity-location binding task with familiar vocabulary and syntax. No open-world reasoning, multi-step event tracking or general dialogue claim. Test groups are reserved and not used for tuning.
